newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria lifts forex restrictions for expatriates.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria lifts forex restrictions for expatriates.

text.p: Nigeria's central bank on Monday said it had lifted a restriction of 75 percent on the proportion of salaries that expatriates are allowed to repatriate.
"Evidence of income earned and taxes paid shall continue to be provided to authorised dealers before remittances are made," the bank's annual policy statement said.

Foreign exchange policy has been progressively liberalised in Africa's most populous nation but a dual exchange rate, which allows the military government cheap access to hard currency, was left untouched in the recent 1997 budget.

The central bank said it had also lifted a yearly travel allowance for Nigerians travelling abroad, which had been pegged at $500, because it had become irrelevant with the free availability of foreign exchange on the open market in recent years.
